name: Account Switch Termination Switch V 01
definition: The AccountSwitchTerminationSwitch message is sent by the new account servicer to the account switch servicer to signal that the account switch must be stopped. The AccountSwitchTerminationSwitch message is only used in exception after the new account servicer has received an AccountSwitchInformationResponse message.

AccountSwitchDetails.name: Account Switch Details
AccountSwitchDetails.definition: Contains information about the details of the account switch, including reasons for the termination of the account switch.

SupplementaryData.name: Supplementary Data
SupplementaryData.definition: Additional information that cannot be captured in the structured elements and/or any other specific block.
